payload.title: [calls-stability-1] #finalizeEnd casts a possibly-undefined room to CallRoomRecord
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING calls-stability-1 (low/stability, confidence=medium, verify-votes +1/-1)

FILE: apps/server/src/calls/call-control-plane.ts
LINES: 607-623

WHAT: #finalizeEnd re-reads the room and spreads `...(room as CallRoomRecord)` (line 614) without a not-found guard. Current callers (endCall line 582, leaveCall line 559) both confirm the room exists before calling, so it is not presently reachable with undefined. But it is a latent NPE/garbage-record hazard: a concurrent end/release that deletes the room between the caller's read and this re-read would spread `undefined` into `{ ...undefined, state: 'ended', endedAt }` and write a malformed room record (only state+endedAt, losing id/createdBy/conversationId).

IMPACT: Low today (no caller reaches it with a missing room), but a future caller or a delete-during-end race would persist a corrupt CallRoom record (missing id/createdBy) and could break subsequent endCall authz (createdBy check) and client sync.

SUGGESTED FIX: Guard #finalizeEnd: if the re-read room is undefined or already 'ended', return early / throw callNotFound instead of casting and spreading undefined.
